```{r}
#| fig-cap: "MPG vs horsepower, colored by transmission."
#| message: false
library(ggplot2)
mtcars2 <- mtcars
mtcars2$am <- factor(mtcars$am, labels = c('automatic', 'manual'))

ggplot(mtcars2, aes(hp, mpg, color = am)) +
  geom_point() + geom_smooth() +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom')
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "World Map Without Australia, Color Indexed."
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(rnaturalearthhires)

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
class(world)

world_without_Australia <- world |> 
  filter(iso_a3 != "AUS")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world_without_Australia,aes(fill = as.factor(mapcolor7)),color = "#401D16", size = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Basic Map of Solomon Islands."
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pacific_groups <- ne_download(scale = 50,type = "admin_0_pacific_groupings")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = pacific_groups)+
  geom_sf(data = world) +
  geom_sf_text(data = world, aes(label = admin))+
  coord_sf(crs = "+proj=ortho +lat_0=0 +lon_0=-160 ") +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(145, 175), ylim = c(-20, 5), expand = FALSE) +
  ggtitle("Solomon Islands", subtitle = "Showing Pacific Island Groupings")+
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Violin Plot on Threat Votes"
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

#import data set
Malicious_Domains <- read_csv("data/3_malicious_domains.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  clean_names()

threat_votes <- Malicious_Domains |>
  select(domain,
         total_engines,
         threat_severity,
         malicious_votes,
         suspicious_votes,
         harmless_votes,
         undetected_votes)

threat_votes_long <- threat_votes |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(malicious_votes,
                        suspicious_votes,
                        harmless_votes,
                        undetected_votes),
               names_to = "vote_type",
               values_to = "votes") |>
  mutate(vote_type = recode(vote_type,
                            malicious_votes = "Malicious",
                            suspicious_votes = "Suspicious",
                            harmless_votes = "Harmless",
                            undetected_votes = "Undetected"))

#create violin plot
violin_plot <- ggplot(threat_votes_long, aes(x = vote_type,
                                             y = votes,
                                             fill = vote_type)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Threat Detection Votes",
       subtitle = "Comparison of security engine classifications across domains",
       x = "Threat Classification",
       y = "Number of Engine Votes",
       fill = "Vote Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.position = "none")

# Display violin plot
print(violin_plot)
```
